claims.text: A Royal Court statement dated Riyadh 26 Jumada II 1426 / 1 August 2005 reports that members of the family pledged allegiance (bay'a) to Crown Prince Abdullah bin Abdulaziz as King in accordance with Article 5 of the Basic Law of Governance.
claims.locator: Dateline; Royal Court statement, sentence 1; trailer (filed 11:06 Makkah time)
claims.uncertainty: Reported in the past tense under the statement's dateline. The statement does not say 'today' and gives no separate date or time for the family pledge, so attested_on is the statement date, not an evidenced pledge date. No coronation, oath or inauguration is described.

claims.text: The same statement reports that, after the pledge was completed, King Abdullah announced the selection of Prince Sultan bin Abdulaziz as Crown Prince in accordance with Article 5, and that the family pledged allegiance to him.
claims.uncertainty: Selection and family pledge are reported by the 1 August 2005 statement without a separate date or time. No Allegiance Commission role is mentioned.

claims.text: The statement says the citizens' pledge to King Abdullah and Crown Prince Sultan will begin at Qasr al-Hukm in Riyadh after noon prayers on the day after tomorrow, Wednesday.
claims.uncertainty: A scheduled event. Counted from the Monday 1 August 2005 dateline, Wednesday is 3 August 2005. This source does not attest that the pledge took place.

scope_note: Arabic original of the Royal Court accession statement. SPA's English release (sa_spa_allegiance_20050801_en) is its translation. Used for SA-EXEC-02.
